title: CrowdStrike's new kill switch can stop rogue AI agents in their tracks, CEO says
summary_full: "Enabling agents to work safely is a massive market opportunity for CrowdStrike," CrowdStrike CEO George Kurtz told CNBC's Jim Cramer.
